metadata.description: Golden dataset of 100 classified error traces covering all 38 failure modes
metadata.coverage: 100% of failure modes with replicas for edge cases

traces.root_cause: missing ledger transaction lock in concurrent payment confirmation
traces.open_code: ledger.CommitTransaction() not protected by mutex

traces.root_cause: race condition between webhook callback and polling retry
traces.open_code: ExecuteWorkflow() called twice without distributed lock

traces.root_cause: incorrect amount rounding in batch consolidation
traces.open_code: ConsolidateSettlementBatch() rounding to nearest rupee instead of paise

traces.root_cause: incorrect merchant grouping logic in consolidation
traces.open_code: merchantGrouping map has collision or missing merchant entry

traces.root_cause: netting accumulator using int64 without overflow check
traces.open_code: nettingSum := int64(0); nettingSum += largeAmount exceeds max int64

traces.root_cause: order status updated before ledger confirmation returned
traces.open_code: order.Status = StatusFulfilled called before ledger.WaitSettlementCompletion() returns

traces.root_cause: settlement committed to ledger but workflow crash before lineage recording
traces.open_code: ledger.CommitTransaction() succeeds but process crashes before lineage.Record()

traces.root_cause: FX rate cache not invalidated, rate >5min old
traces.open_code: fxCache.Get(EUR_INR) returns cached rate without TTL check

traces.root_cause: CBDC ledger timeout with no automatic retry logic
traces.open_code: ConsolidateSettlementBatch() context.Context timeout not handled with retry

traces.root_cause: settlement batch record omitted from ledger snapshot due to timing race
traces.open_code: ledger snapshot taken mid-transaction, settlement batch not included

traces.root_cause: ledger write not synchronized with read, eventual consistency violated
traces.open_code: ledger.Commit() returns but ledger.Query() shows stale state

traces.root_cause: settlement retry triggered without max retry counter or exponential backoff
traces.open_code: for { retry() } infinite loop, no break condition

traces.root_cause: velocity cache stale, using cached results from 2 hours ago
traces.open_code: velocityChecker.Check() returns cached result without TTL validation

traces.root_cause: concurrent order submission race condition, velocity window calculation off-by-one
traces.open_code: velocityWindow := time.Now().Add(-1*time.Hour) uses wrong boundary

traces.root_cause: fuzzy name matching threshold too high (0.85 instead of 0.95)
traces.open_code: nameDistance("Ahmed Khan", "Ahmed Khan Ltd") > 0.85 passes check

traces.root_cause: KYC status check missing from order creation handler
traces.open_code: handleCreateOrder() does not call merchant.IsKYCComplete()

traces.root_cause: consent check bypassed in settlement flow, no consent.Verify() call
traces.open_code: queryCustomerBankBalance() called without consent verification

traces.root_cause: reversed orders not excluded from regulatory report
traces.open_code: reportQuery does not filter WHERE status != 'reversed'

traces.root_cause: customer risk score cached for 24h, PEP designation added in meantime
traces.open_code: riskScoreCache TTL = 24h, should be 4h

traces.root_cause: compliance decision executed but not logged to audit trail
traces.open_code: complianceCheck() returns result but does not call lineage.Record()

traces.root_cause: document verification using simple image comparison, no liveness check
traces.open_code: verifyDocument() uses image.Compare(), not certified e-KYC provider

traces.root_cause: velocity limit lowered from 100k to 50k, transaction approved under old rule
traces.open_code: no rule snapshot at transaction start, uses current rule throughout

traces.root_cause: no validation of current state before transition, skipped payment step
traces.open_code: order.Status = StatusFulfilled without checking current state

traces.root_cause: no timeout set on payment agent RPC call
traces.open_code: paymentAgent.InitiatePayment(ctx) with infinite context timeout

traces.root_cause: no dependency check between workflow steps, settlement initiated while payment pending
traces.open_code: ExecuteWorkflow() step sequence not validated, can execute in any order

traces.root_cause: no idempotency key on payment request, retry triggers before first completes
traces.open_code: InitiatePayment(orderID) called twice with same orderID, no idempotency

traces.root_cause: workflow state not persisted to durable store, crash during settlement
traces.open_code: ledger.CommitTransaction() succeeds but process.Exit() before lineage.Record()

traces.root_cause: no mutex lock in ExecuteWorkflow(), webhook and polling fire simultaneously
traces.open_code: ExecuteWorkflow() reads o.state without o.mu lock

traces.root_cause: payment agent returns error but not checked, settlement proceeds as if success
traces.open_code: _ = paymentAgent.InitiatePayment(ctx) ignores error return

traces.root_cause: rollback logic not transactional, ledger refund succeeds but order status not rolled back
traces.open_code: ledger.Refund() succeeds but rollbackOrderStatus() fails silently

traces.root_cause: settlement waits for payment confirmed, payment polling waits for settlement start
traces.open_code: settlement step blocks on paymentStep.IsComplete(), payment step blocks on settlementStep.Start()

traces.root_cause: weak merchant document verification, no business registration validation
traces.open_code: verifyMerchantDocument() uses simple PAN regex, no GST registry lookup

traces.root_cause: duplicate card check only per customer, no aggregate velocity across linked accounts
traces.open_code: velocityCheck(customerID) does not query cardToAccountGraph

traces.root_cause: message queue failure, dispute handler crashed without retry logic
traces.open_code: disputeQueue.Consume() crashed, message lost, no dead-letter queue

traces.root_cause: no IFSC/account validation before transfer, funds sent to wrong account
traces.open_code: validateBankAccount(ifsc, account) not called before funds transfer

traces.root_cause: refund not triggered on payment failure, refund agent unavailable
traces.open_code: onPaymentFailure() does not call refundAgent.IssueRefund()

traces.root_cause: no integration with card networks for chargeback notification
traces.open_code: onChargebackNotification() received but not logged to lineage

traces.root_cause: commission percentage applied to gross instead of net
traces.open_code: commission = (settlement * 0.02) uses gross amount instead of referral net

traces.root_cause: account auto-locked after 3 failed KYC re-verifications with no recovery path
traces.open_code: if verificationFailures >= 3 { account.Lock() } with no unlock mechanism

traces.root_cause: KYC expiry date not checked before order, expired KYC not enforced
traces.open_code: isKYCValid() does not check kycVerificationDate against 12-month window

traces.root_cause: LLM agent not grounded in deterministic order lookup, generates amount
traces.open_code: settlementAgent.GetAmount() returns LLM generated value not from database

traces.root_cause: user input concatenated into agent prompt without sanitization
traces.open_code: agentPrompt = 'Process order: ' + userInput (no escaping)

traces.root_cause: context not persisted between turns, LLM temperature too high
traces.open_code: agent.temperature = 0.7 in turn 1, different context in turn 2

traces.root_cause: settlement agent selects fraud-detection tool instead of compliance check
traces.open_code: settlementAgent.SelectTool('verify_merchant') returns fraudDetector instead of kycChecker

traces.root_cause: LLM refusal due to misaligned safety guardrails, reason not logged
traces.open_code: settlementAgent refuses to process batch without logging reason

traces.root_cause: agent fine-tuned on settlement speed, approves high-risk customers
traces.open_code: complianceAgent optimized for SLA targets, ignores AML rules

traces.root_cause: agent prompt + context exceeds model context window limit
traces.open_code: settlementAgent history 500k tokens > 4k context window

traces.root_cause: lineage entry modified without hash recomputation
traces.open_code: lineageEntry.Amount = 5000 (changed from 500) without lineageEntry.Hash = recompute()

traces.root_cause: audit entry created without all required fields, no schema validation
traces.open_code: AuditEntry{ID, OrderID} missing Input/Output amounts and timestamp

traces.root_cause: audit entry timestamp modified to appear within SLA
traces.open_code: lineageEntry.Timestamp = time.Now().Add(-8*time.Hour) manually set

traces.root_cause: order status updated but ledger and lineage not synchronized atomically
traces.open_code: order.Status = Fulfilled done, but ledger.Status = Pending, lineage.Status = Cancelled

traces.root_cause: lineage API response not signed, MITM tampering possible
traces.open_code: lineage.Query() response over unencrypted channel, no signature validation

traces.root_cause: settlement lineage deleted for GDPR but deletion not logged
traces.open_code: DELETE FROM lineage WHERE customer_id = X (no deletion log entry)

traces.root_cause: sensitive lineage data (SSN, card details) logged without encryption
traces.open_code: AuditEntry.Input contains full SSN and card number, accessible via API

traces.root_cause: double-spend triggered by velocity bypass and race condition
traces.open_code: AML velocity cache stale, concurrent payment race, both commit

traces.root_cause: orchestrator crash causes settlement ledger, order status, and lineage mismatch
traces.open_code: ledger.Commit() succeeds but process.Crash() before lineage.Record() and order.Update()

traces.root_cause: netting overflow in large bilateral multilateral settlement
traces.open_code: nettingSum accumulated to int64.MaxValue + 1

traces.root_cause: regulatory report includes reversed order, amount discrepancy
traces.open_code: reportQuery missing WHERE order.Status != 'Reversed'

traces.root_cause: settlement agent timeout without retry
traces.open_code: context.WithTimeout(ctx, 5*time.Second) with no retry logic

traces.root_cause: refund not issued due to refund agent timeout and no SLA enforcement
traces.open_code: issueRefund() timeout with no fallback mechanism

traces.root_cause: compliance agent alignment drift towards speed vs. safety
traces.open_code: agent fine-tuning objective prioritizes SLA completion over AML rule enforcement

traces.root_cause: audit entry missing critical context fields for later investigation
traces.open_code: struct AuditEntry{ID, OrderID} no Amount, Timestamp, or Error fields

traces.root_cause: refactoring of ConsolidateSettlementBatch introduced merchant grouping bug
traces.open_code: merchantGrouping[merchant.ID] = order omits duplicate merchant check

traces.root_cause: performance optimization reintroduced velocity cache without TTL validation
traces.open_code: velocityCache.Get() added back without TTL check

traces.root_cause: fuzzy match threshold increased for performance, reintroducing false negatives
traces.open_code: nameMatchThreshold changed from 0.95 back to 0.85

traces.root_cause: ledger lock contention under high volume, occasional race condition
traces.open_code: mutex contention on ledger.mu under 10k concurrent orders

traces.root_cause: ledger latency increases under high volume, SLA timeout triggered
traces.open_code: ledger.CommitTransaction() p99 latency > 5s timeout at 5k orders/min

traces.root_cause: netting calculation with zero amounts causes unexpected state
traces.open_code: nettingSum += 0 not handled, sentinel value check missing

traces.root_cause: settlement amount at int64 boundary triggers overflow
traces.open_code: nettingSum = 9,223,372,036,854,775,807 + 1 = integer overflow

traces.root_cause: FX conversion results in negative amount due to rounding error
traces.open_code: fxConvert(100, rate=-0.5) produces negative result

traces.root_cause: settlement batch consolidation with zero orders
traces.open_code: ConsolidateSettlementBatch(orders=[]) produces unexpected state

traces.root_cause: same order appears twice in settlement batch
traces.open_code: orders = [order1, order2, order1] not deduplicated

traces.root_cause: system clock adjustment causes lineage timestamp inversion
traces.open_code: settlement at 17:00 but clock adjusted back to 09:00, timestamp recorded as 09:00

traces.root_cause: regulatory report boundary at midnight misses settlement at 23:59:59
traces.open_code: reportDate filter uses midnight boundary, off-by-one in time window

traces.root_cause: batch consolidation algorithm O(n^2), performance degradation on large batches
traces.open_code: ConsolidateSettlementBatch() nested loops on orders and merchants

traces.root_cause: velocity check queries entire transaction history, not indexed
traces.open_code: SELECT * FROM transactions WHERE customer_id = X (no index on customer_id)

traces.root_cause: KYC expiry check uses > instead of >=, 12-month-old KYC still valid
traces.open_code: if age > 365 days { require_renewal } should use >= 365 days

traces.root_cause: velocity check uses >= but customer exactly at limit approved
traces.open_code: if totalAmount > limit { block } should use >=

traces.root_cause: dependent ledger service unavailable, settlement timeout
traces.open_code: ledger.CommitTransaction() returns context deadline exceeded

traces.root_cause: external sanctions list service slow response, timeout fallback
traces.open_code: sanctionsList.Query() timeout, fallback to cached list

traces.root_cause: payment and settlement agents execute out of order due to async messaging
traces.open_code: settlement agent processes message before payment agent confirms

traces.root_cause: compliance check async, settlement proceeds before result returned
traces.open_code: settlement doesn't await complianceAgent.Check() result

traces.root_cause: no failure detected - happy path
traces.open_code: all checks passed, settlement succeeded

traces.root_cause: payment succeeds, settlement fails, rollback incomplete
traces.open_code: ledger refund issued but order status rollback fails
